purpose: Batch manifest for reference-guided soft-farm candidate generation covering second-wave root crops and one base material. This is a planning/review artifact only and does not edit live assets.

cluster_reference_policy.required_cluster: Soft farm / pet / crop / button / scroll UI
rules: Use the matching soft-farm reference pack first.
Do not cross-pollinate battle, node UI, or environment clusters unless explicitly bridging styles.
Generate the crop/material set together where possible so edges, materials, proportions, and inventory readability stay consistent.
Keep outputs as candidates until visual review, cutout cleanup, alpha/bounding-box checks, and in-browser verification pass.

source_docs.notes: Defines root crops as functional/alchemy materials and material_wood_raw as a base material.
Defines second-wave root crop and base material family positioning, visual keywords, and unity requirements.
Defines clustered references and candidate-first asset workflow.

reference_anchors.notes: Prior soft-farm candidate batch generated by image_edit from Terra master soft_farm cluster.
Prior selected/processed soft-farm beast assets; use only as style/proportion reference, not as target outputs.

items.candidate_prompt_brief: Soft-farm inventory/crop candidate sheet for crop_moon_turnip: a pale moonlit turnip root crop, rounded readable tuber body with tiny leaves, warm hand-painted Terra Chronicle soft farm style, three-quarter top-down icon/sprite readability, transparent or clean simple background, not sticker-like, not photorealistic.

Soft-farm inventory/crop candidate sheet for crop_iron_tuber: a heavy earthy tuber with iron-rich skin and subtle mineral flecks, chunky durable silhouette, small robust sprout, warm hand-painted Terra Chronicle soft farm style, readable at inventory size, transparent or clean simple background.

Soft-farm inventory/crop candidate sheet for crop_moss_radish: a moss-capped radish root with damp soil texture and soft green fuzz, clearly distinct from moon_turnip and iron_tuber, warm hand-painted Terra Chronicle soft farm style, top-down three-quarter sprite/icon readability, transparent or clean simple background.

Soft-farm inventory material candidate sheet for material_wood_raw: one or two humble raw logs with readable bark and cut wood grain, simple base-resource silhouette, warm hand-painted Terra Chronicle soft farm style, strong contrast on parchment/inventory backgrounds, transparent or clean simple background.

review_checklist: Confirm all four items share soft-farm cluster material treatment and do not drift into battle/node/environment style.
Confirm moon_turnip, iron_tuber, and moss_radish silhouettes are distinguishable at inventory size.
Confirm material_wood_raw reads as a humble base material and contrasts against parchment UI.
Reject candidates with sticker-like outlines, AI gloss, full-scene backgrounds, inconsistent perspective, fuzzy edges, or baked UI frames.
Only after selection: cut out, remove color fringe, crop/resize, record alpha bounding box, and verify in real browser before live integration.
